nodes.name: Jeremy Boreing

claims.label: Host Says Erika Kirk Hosted TPUSA Corporate Zoom Call on September 16, 2025
claims.claim: The host says a corporate-wide Zoom call addressed by Erika Kirk to Turning Point USA employees took place on September 16, 2025, approximately five-and-a-half days after Charlie Kirk's death, with the public board announcement following one day later.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify call metadata, attendee list, and recording provenance; cross-reference against the September 17 public board announcement (A-1687.1).

claims.label: Erika Kirk's Sept 16 Call Opened With Laughter and Visible "Thumbs Up" Reactions
claims.claim: In a clip of the opening of the September 16 Zoom call that the host plays, Erika Kirk says "Oh, look at all the thumbs up" and "this is a little bit more emotional than probably Charlie would be reacting"; the host says she starts by laughing.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain unedited full recording; confirm reaction icons, laughter timing, and participant count.

claims.label: Erika Kirk Framed TPUSA Staff as "Family" on Sept 16 Call
claims.claim: In a clip of the September 16 call that the host plays, Erika Kirk repeatedly addresses Turning Point USA employees as "family," stating "your family if you want to," "I want our family to stay together," and "this is your chosen family."
claims.investigative_direction: Compile every instance of "family" usage; obtain termination records of named attendees to verify the host's juxtaposition.

claims.label: Erika Kirk Promised Job Security to TPUSA Staff on Sept 16 Call
claims.claim: During the September 16 call, Erika Kirk stated, "I will fight like hell to make sure that all of you have a job here" and "I will make sure that I never allow a point to where you have to leave because we cannot financially afford you."
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference against TPUSA termination data from Q4 2025 onward; identify whether attendees retained employment.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Kirk Self-Corrected to Avoid the Word "Happy" About Charlie on Sept 16 Call
claims.claim: The host says that in a clip of the September 16 call, Erika Kirk interrupted herself mid-sentence with "I'm trying not to say that he would be," appearing to self-edit away from a positive emotion descriptor about Charlie Kirk in heaven.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain unedited recording; confirm whether the self-correction is verbatim as transcribed.

claims.label: Erika Kirk's Sept 16 Call Included "Be Soft With One Another in Ways Differently"
claims.claim: During the September 16 call, Erika Kirk told TPUSA employees to "be soft with one another in ways differently" and that "if someone's acting weird, don't read into that… weddings and funerals bring out the weirdest side of people."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify exact phrasing on unedited recording; trace adoption timeline of the "everybody grieves differently" framing across TPUSA communications.

claims.label: Erika Kirk's Sept 16 Call Included "15 Minutes Before Landing" Analogy Attributed to "Usha"
claims.claim: In a clip of the September 16 call that the host plays, Erika Kirk shares an airplane analogy ("15 minutes before landing… you're going to make it through these next 15 minutes") attributed to a person named "Usha."
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the "Usha" referenced; verify identity and whether the analogy was shared privately on the tarmac as Erika describes.

claims.label: TPUSA Board Announcement Letter (Sept 17) Was Signed Off by Doug DeGroote
claims.claim: The host says the September 17, 2025 public letter announcing Erika Kirk as Turning Point USA's new CEO and Chair was signed off by Doug DeGroote, whom she says is on the board.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original signed letter; verify Doug DeGroote's role on the TPUSA board at the time of issuance.

claims.label: TPUSA Board Letter Invoked Ecclesiastes and Framed the Appointment as Divinely Ordained
claims.claim: The host reads the September 17, 2025 board letter announcing Erika Kirk as CEO and chair, which opens by citing Ecclesiastes, saying King Solomon wrote that "mankind is to be tested by God," and adds "Today we are facing such a test."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify exact wording against original letter; document all subsequent TPUSA communications invoking similar framing.

claims.label: Jeremy Boreing Described Hiring Candace Owens as His "Biggest Professional Mistake"
claims.claim: In a podcast interview, Jeremy Boreing stated, "I certainly think that hiring Candace is probably the biggest mistake of my professional life so far."
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the source podcast and episode date; verify Boreing's full context for the statement.

claims.label: Jeremy Boreing Characterized Candace Owens as "Nuclear Energy" Capable of "Flattening a City"
claims.claim: In a podcast interview, Jeremy Boreing stated: "Candace is like nuclear energy, you know, if you if you harness it properly, she can power a city. If you lose control, she'll flatten the city."
claims.investigative_direction: Identify source podcast and date; verify exact quote and surrounding context.

claims.label: Jeremy Boreing Compared Candace Owens's Show to "Rhetorical Pornography"
claims.claim: In a podcast interview, Jeremy Boreing stated Candace Owens "is at war with the widow of her purported best friend" and characterized her content as a "kind of pornography" and "rhetorical pornography," adding that "you shouldn't be able to look at it if you're under 18."
claims.investigative_direction: Identify source podcast and date; verify quote against full unedited clip.

claims.label: Jeremy Boreing Claimed Candace Said "I Believe What the People Believe" on Two Occasions
claims.claim: In a podcast interview, Jeremy Boreing claimed that on two separate occasions when he asked Candace what she believes, she answered, "I believe what the people believe. I am the voice of the people."
claims.investigative_direction: Identify source podcast and date; verify whether Candace Owens has ever publicly responded to or denied this characterization.

claims.label: The Bulwark Reported Daily Wire Production Involved 100+ Extras in a Hungarian Marsh, Travel to Italy, and Bulls Imported From Spain
claims.claim: In a Bulwark podcast segment the host plays, a speaker describes Daily Wire's Hungary production as including approximately 100 extras staging fist fights in a marsh, traveling to Italy for additional filming, and importing bulls from Spain for the production.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the Bulwark episode and date; verify whether Daily Wire or Boreing has disputed these production details.

claims.label: Terryl Farnsworth Was in the Background of the Sept 16 TPUSA Call
claims.claim: During the September 16 Zoom call playback, host identifies Terryl Farnsworth as in the background of the recording.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm Terryl Farnsworth's identity and role at TPUSA at the time of the call; verify whether he was a scheduled participant.

claims.label: Host Calls Boreing's BLM-Era Hiring Remarks "Objectively Racist"
claims.claim: Candace Owens asserts that Boreing's remarks about why he hired her, which she paraphrases as tied to her willingness to critique Black Lives Matter, are "objectively racist."
claims.investigative_direction: Evaluate the host's interpretive claim against the verbatim Boreing quote; consider whether Boreing's prior public statements confirm or rebut this framing.

claims.label: Host Rejects Boreing's "Rhetorical Pornography" Comparison
claims.claim: Candace Owens rejects Boreing's pornography analogy, saying one of the reasons she was fired was that she said the history of pornography should be looked into, and that people should talk about real pornography and where it comes from.
claims.investigative_direction: Document the factual claims about Israeli sexual blackmail and Gaza pornography broadcasts; identify primary sources for each.

claims.label: Host Says Boreing's "I Believe What the People Believe" Account Is Made Up
claims.claim: Candace Owens rejects Boreing's account of her saying "I believe what the people believe," describing it as "obviously made up."
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Boreing's account against any other contemporaneous documentation of the alleged conversations.

claims.label: Host Concurs With Bulwark Reporting on Daily Wire Hungary Production Costs
claims.claim: Candace Owens concurs with the Bulwark speaker's characterization of Daily Wire's Hungary production as financially extravagant and possibly connected to the departure agreement.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify any public Daily Wire financial disclosures or departure-agreement terms that corroborate Bulwark's reporting.

claims.label: Host Says Everybody Grieves Differently Was First Used Inside TPUSA on the Sept 16 Call
claims.claim: The host says that the expression 'everybody grieves differently' was first uttered inside Turning Point USA, on a corporate-wide Zoom call five and a half days after the assassination, before the memorial.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full recording of the September 16 call and search the transcript for the phrase 'grieves differently'; compare with the first public use by TPUSA-aligned accounts.
claims.transcript_snippet: who actually uttered that expression first over at Turning Point USA, before Charlie's memorial. In a corporate-wide phone call

claims.label: Host Says Boreing Compared Her and Tucker Carlson to Antifa and Her Show to Pornography
claims.claim: The host says Jeremy Boreing publicly attacked Tucker Carlson and her, correlating them to antifa thugs, and also compared her show to pornography.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the Boreing podcast interview and check whether he used the word antifa about the host and Carlson.
claims.transcript_snippet: publicly attacking Tucker Carlson and yours truly, correlating us to antifa thugs. And also this show to pornography.

claims.label: Host Corrects Photo: Man Shown Was Bob Ferguson of Iowa, Not Bob Flood of Chicago
claims.claim: The host says the previous episode showed a picture of a man she believed was Bob Flood of Chicago, but he is Bob Ferguson of Iowa and has nothing to do with the story; she says the image was removed and she apologizes.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the removed segment of the prior episode with the corrected version and confirm the image is gone from all uploads.
claims.transcript_snippet: His name was actually Bob Fergus- Ferguson. He's from Iowa. He has nothing to do with the story.

claims.label: Host Says She Spoke With Fired Employees Who Were Not Her Leakers
claims.claim: The host says she has now spoken with employees who were let go in the recent string of aggressive firings, that they did nothing wrong, and that they were not the people leaking to her.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the names of the separated employees (from the host or former staff) and TPUSA separation records to test whether any leaked to the host.
claims.transcript_snippet: after now speaking with employees who were let go in this recent string of aggressive firings, employees that did nothing

claims.label: Host Says Erika Was Intimately Involved in the PR Campaign Against Her
claims.claim: The host says she firmly believes from the beginning that Erika Kirk was intimately involved in the PR messaging and PR campaign against her at different times.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the PR firm or agency engaged by TPUSA and any messages or contracts showing Erika Kirk approved statements about the host.
claims.transcript_snippet: I do believe firmly from the beginning that Erika was intimately involved in the PR messaging and the PR campaign at different times against me

claims.label: Host Says Erika Lied to Her Face About Superman Neck and Blamed Kolvet
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk lied to her face about the 'Superman neck' statement, blaming Andrew Kolvet and saying he went rogue, and also that Dr. Lee Trotter went rogue.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the host's notes or recording of the private meeting with Erika Kirk against Kolvet's surgeon post and any statement from Dr. Trotter.
claims.transcript_snippet: She lied to my face actually regarding the Superman neck. She blamed that on Andrew Kolbint, said that he went rogue, that Dr. Lee Trotter also went rogue

claims.label: Host Says Erika Claimed the Two Men Violated HIPAA Without Her Knowledge
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk told her that Kolvet and Dr. Lee Trotter violated HIPAA by hopping on the phone and acting without her consent or knowledge.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the recording or notes of the private meeting and any hospital HIPAA complaint or response regarding Dr. Trotter.
claims.transcript_snippet: violated HIPAA, that they hopped on the phone and did this without her consent or knowledge

claims.label: Host Says It Was a Three-Way Call and the Superman Neck Statement Came From Erika
claims.claim: The host says she told her audience the doctor did not violate HIPAA, that it was a three-way call, and that the statement about 'Superman neck' came from Erika Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain call records for the three-way call and the surgeon's account, and compare with the wording of Kolvet's post.
claims.transcript_snippet: It was actually a three-way call and the statement pertaining to Superman neck came from her.

claims.label: Host Says Kolvet Was Doing Erika's Bidding and Taking a Bullet for Her
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Kolvet, in sending the surgeon tweet, was doing Erika Kirk's bidding and taking a figurative bullet for her.
claims.investigative_direction: Look for messages between Kolvet and Erika Kirk around the surgeon call that show who authorized the post.
claims.transcript_snippet: Andrew Kolbint in that regard was doing Erika's bidding. He was taking a figurative bullet for her.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Knew She Was on the Call and Did Not Misspeak
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk did not misspeak: she lied to the doctor and knew she was on the three-way call.
claims.investigative_direction: Interview the surgeon or his intermediary and obtain phone records for the day of the call.
claims.transcript_snippet: She lied to the doctor, a surgeon, and she knew that she was on that call.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Was Confirmed Present at the Hamptons Retreat When Netanyahu Called
claims.claim: The host says it has now been confirmed that Erika Kirk was at the Hamptons retreat and was present when Benjamin Netanyahu called.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the attendee list and travel records for the August 2025 Hamptons retreat and the call log for the Netanyahu call.
claims.transcript_snippet: We've also now confirmed that she was at the Hamptons retreat, the now infamous uh Hamptons retreat.

claims.label: Host Says Two Unrelated People Confirmed Kolvet's Account of the Netanyahu Funding Offer
claims.claim: The host says she has confirmed Andrew Kolvet's account that Netanyahu offered to fund Turning Point to the next level with two people not related to Kolvet.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the two confirming sources' accounts (anonymized if necessary) and Kolvet's original statement.
claims.transcript_snippet: I have since confirmed what Andrew Kolvet said with two people that are not related to Andrew Kolvet at all.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Recalls No Offer and Says Bibi Called About Charlie's May Letter
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk, though confirming she was at the dinner, says no funding offer was made and that Netanyahu was calling about the letter Charlie Kirk wrote him in May.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Erika Kirk's account with Kolvet's and with the May 2025 letter released by Netanyahu's office.
claims.transcript_snippet: She says that there was not an offer that was made and that Bibi was calling about the letter that Charlie wrote him back in May.

claims.label: Host Says Kolvet Told Her Charlie Called the Summit an Intervention Over Israel
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Kolvet confirmed to her that Charlie Kirk described the Hamptons summit as an intervention being staged over Israel.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Kolvet's original account and any contemporaneous messages in which Charlie Kirk characterized the summit.
claims.transcript_snippet: Andrew uh confirmed to me that Charlie described that summit as like an intervention was being staged over Israel.

claims.label: Host Says Erika and Kolvet Worked Together on the Fort Huachuca PR Response
claims.claim: The host says it has been confirmed that Erika Kirk and Andrew Kolvet worked together on the Fort Huachuca PR response.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify who drafted and approved the Fort Huachuca response and obtain the messages coordinating it.
claims.transcript_snippet: We have also confirmed that Erika and Andrew are working together on that Fort Huachuca PR response.

claims.label: Host Says the Response Went Through Paramount Tactical Rather Than to Her After Their Four-Hour Meeting
claims.claim: The host says the Fort Huachuca response was handled through the YouTuber Paramount Tactical rather than going directly to her after her roughly four-hour conversation with Erika Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain communications between TPUSA and Paramount Tactical and the date of the host's meeting with Erika Kirk.
claims.transcript_snippet: Rather than going directly to me after we sat down, that to me seems like a pretty uh strong violation of a well-meaning conversation that I had with her for 4 hours.

claims.label: Host Says Paramount Tactical Also Dug Into Mitch's Entire Past
claims.claim: The host says the same YouTuber, Paramount Tactical, also went into 'Mitch's' entire past (transcribed with 'Mitch McConnell's past').
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm which Mitch is meant (Mitch Snow is the likely reference) and review Paramount Tactical's videos about him.
claims.transcript_snippet: that was the same YouTuber despite, you know, also going into Mitch's entire past

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Welcomed Paramount Tactical Onto Charlie Kirk's Show While She Was in a Hotel
claims.claim: The host says that after calling for a ceasefire and a sit-down, TPUSA welcomed Paramount Tactical onto Charlie Kirk's podcast show to debunk her while she was in a hotel room, and she did not know it was happening.
claims.investigative_direction: Find the Charlie Kirk Show episode with Paramount Tactical and its air date relative to the host's meeting.
claims.transcript_snippet: they welcomed Paramount Tactical onto Charlie Kirk's podcast show while I was in this hotel room to debunk me.

claims.label: Host Says Kolvet Was Caught Live Messaging From Erika After She Said He Was Out of PR
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Kolvet was caught live messaging something from Erika Kirk after Erika told her TPUSA was disappointed in Kolvet and that he would no longer be involved in PR.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the livestream in which Kolvet was seen messaging and the content and timing of the message.
claims.transcript_snippet: him being caught live, Andrew Kolvet at live messaging something from Erika after she told me that they were disappointed in Andrew, that he wasn't going to be involved in PR anymore.

claims.label: Host Says Kolvet Told Her He Collapsed Crying Into Erika's Arms on the Provo Tarmac
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Kolvet told her that when he stepped off the plane in Provo on September 10 he basically collapsed crying into Erika Kirk's arms on the tarmac.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain airport video, flight records and eyewitness accounts of the September 10 tarmac meeting at Provo.
claims.transcript_snippet: when he stepped off of the plane in Provo on September 10th, he basically collapsed into Erika's arms crying on the tarmac

claims.label: Host Says She Was Led to Think Kolvet Flew Alone, Then Was Told His Wife Was Aboard
claims.claim: The host says her impression was that Andrew Kolvet was alone on the plane to Provo, but she was later told he was accompanied by his wife.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the passenger manifest for Kolvet's September 10 flight to Provo.
claims.transcript_snippet: the impression that I got was that Andrew was on that plane alone. But then we were later told that Andrew was accompanied by his wife.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Had No Recollection of Kolvet's Wife and Could Not Say if She Flew In
claims.claim: The host says that in their face-to-face meeting Erika Kirk had no recollection of Kolvet's wife stepping off the plane and could not answer whether he flew in with his wife.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with the manifest and eyewitness accounts; ask Erika Kirk's office to confirm or deny.
claims.transcript_snippet: Erika during our face-to-face meeting had no recollection of his wife stepping off of the plane.

claims.label: Host Says Per Kolvet Erika Waited an Hour on the Tarmac for His Flight
claims.claim: The host says that, if Andrew Kolvet is to be believed, Erika Kirk waited for an hour on the tarmac for his flight to land.
claims.investigative_direction: Reconcile Erika Kirk's September 10 movements with flight arrival times at Provo.
claims.transcript_snippet: if Andrew is to be believed, then she waited for an hour on the tarmac for Andrew's flight to land.

claims.label: Host Says Kolvet and Erika Entered the Hospital by Separate Entrances
claims.claim: The host says that, per Kolvet's account, he went in through the front main entrance where other TPUSA staff were and Erika Kirk went in through a back or side entrance.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain hospital entrance accounts from staff present on September 10, 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: Andrew went through the front main entry a main entrance where there were other TPUSA staff there, people that were there on that day, and Erika went in through a back or side entrance.

claims.label: Host Says Kolvet Told Her the Board Had Picked Erika Within About 72 Hours
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Kolvet told her, before the public announcement, that the board had selected Erika Kirk within about 72 hours of Charlie Kirk's death.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain TPUSA board minutes or written consent recording the date of the CEO vote.
claims.transcript_snippet: Andrew Kolvet told me before the public knew that the board had selected Erika with within about 72 hours of Charlie's death.

claims.label: Host Reasons Erika Had to Consent Before the Board Vote
claims.claim: The host reasons that, to have her name put to a board vote within about 72 hours, Erika Kirk had to give her consent first.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the board resolution and any record of when Erika Kirk agreed to be nominated.
claims.transcript_snippet: She had to give her consent for that to go up for a board vote.

claims.label: Host Says She Publicly Said TPUSA Should Have Appointed an Interim CEO
claims.claim: The host says she stated publicly that Turning Point USA should have waited and appointed an interim CEO so Erika Kirk had time to grieve.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the host's earlier public statement calling for an interim CEO.
claims.transcript_snippet: Turning Point USA should have waited and instead appointed an interim CEO to allow Erika the time that she needed to grieve

claims.label: Host Says Erika Brought No Member of Her Own Family to Utah
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk did not bring a single member of her actual family with her to Utah, only the Turning Point family.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain accounts from Erika Kirk's relatives and hospital staff on who accompanied her on September 10.
claims.transcript_snippet: it is stunning to me that Erika chose not to bring a single member of her actual family with her to Utah.
